implementation_invariants: The engine contains no network data fetch for 0048 and accepts historical market data only through the frozen 0047 evidence identity.
BTC eligibility reuses the canonical 0047 trend_score and FAST weights rather than introducing a second trend implementation.
ETH/SOL feature and probability exchange symmetry is mechanically tested on synthetic data.
14/28/56 forward target equivalence is mechanically tested against the literal preregistered formula.
Training-label maturity is exactly 56 calendar days and is tested without historical 0048 output.
Walk-forward refits are every 28 calendar days from the first valid shadow anchor and only use expanding matured eligible labels.
Primary temperature calibration is shadow-prequential and prior preserving; no in-sample fitted probability calibration is implemented.
Moving-block bootstrap samples aligned candidate/baseline rows with identical indices and does not retrain models inside bootstrap replicates.
The segmented breakpoint implementation computes the deterministic global SSE minimum over the admissible [0.20,0.80] one-breakpoint family with smaller-kappa tie breaking.
Spline second derivatives are diagnostic only and have no threshold-selection authority.
No portfolio allocation, CAGR, MDD, Beta-to-BTC or BTC-to-cash calculation exists in the implementation surface.
